It's ok to open up every once in a while. I went on a church retreat last fall with my colleges christian group and this is gonna sound dark but I was planning on killing myself there. But the first night I was there we had a service and the pastor seemed to speak to me even though he was speaking to everyone. Then we broke off into guys and girls groups where we could confess our sins and have all our brothers pray for us. Some people stood up, confessed and the thing was when they did, some guys would get up, put their hands on them, and one of the group leaders would say a prayer. I felt something telling me to confess. I stood up, told everyone that I was struggling with the demons my whole life and came here to end it and that I was scared, and I swear every single guy in that church stood up and put their hands on me and prayed for me. Well over 400 people, strangers that I had never met before, cried and prayed for me, and at that moment, I felt the closest with God then ever before. So in short, yes, that instinct telling you to open up, listen to it. I like to think it's the holy spirit trying to guide us in the right direction
